meaning: Correct this retained hamlet’s Arabic display spelling from الخرمية to الكرمية. Preserve the existing French El Kharmia search spelling and add the independently published El Karmia. This is not a formal legal renaming, point move, administrative transfer, or polygon interpretation.

primaryEvidence.finding: Nabeul governorate spells the modern locality الكرمية in its account of former El Kalbia.
INP explicitly describes El Karmia as a village in Grombalia and places site029.042 at the village exit near the college. It is used for inhabited name/context, not as the hamlet point or outline.
MP Mohamed Ali Fnira names كرمية among Grombalia villages in a residential-housing discussion. This is primary public testimony, not a ministerial survey.
